map.Markdown 是写作与文档的主流轻量标记语言。ToolBox Markdow: Markdown is the mainstream lightweight markup language for writing and documentation. The ToolBox Markdown to HTML tool renders .md text into HTML fragments locally in real time, ready to paste into a web page or rich text editor.
map.实时渲染：左边写 Markdown，右边出 HTML: Live rendering: Markdown on the left, HTML on the right
map.支持标题、列表、表格、代码块、引用等常用语法: Supports common syntax such as headings, lists, tables, code blocks and quotes
map.输出干净 HTML 片段，可直接使用: Outputs a clean HTML fragment ready to use
map.把笔记/文档转成网页可发布的 HTML: Turn notes or documents into HTML ready to publish on the web
map.在 CMS 中粘贴结构化内容: Paste structured content into a CMS
map.教学/报告中快速排版: Fast layout for teaching or reports
map.在左侧粘贴或输入 Markdown 文本: Paste or type Markdown text on the left
map.右侧实时显示渲染后的 HTML: Rendered HTML shown live on the right
map.如需 HTML 源码，切换到源码视图并复制: If you need the HTML source, switch to source view and copy
map.检查表格、代码块等是否如预期: Check whether tables, code blocks and the rest look as expected
map.粘贴到目标编辑器时注意清理多余样式: Clean up extra styling when pasting into the target editor
